name: emw-relion-subset-selection
help: Keep the particles of the selected 3D classes from a Class3D job (relion_star_handler). Inspect the classes of the 3D classification, then list the class numbers to keep.

params.name: relion_subset_selection.optimiser
params.label: Select classes from:
params.help: The *_optimiser.star or *_optimisation_set.star file of the 3D classification iteration, e.g. Class3D/job017/run_it025_optimisation_set.star. The particles are read from the matching *_data.star file.

params.name: relion_subset_selection.classes
params.label: Classes to keep:
params.help: Class numbers to keep, separated by commas or spaces. Ranges are allowed, e.g. '1,3-4' keeps classes 1, 3 and 4. The output is particles.star with the particles of these classes.
